subject: FB-3: KB-inject driver (export-kb → AGENTS.md)
description: Build the KB injection path for the two ON arms. Steps: (1) onboard each unique fast-split repo at its pinned commit via scripts/onboard-loop.js; (2) scripts/export-kb.js → write the KB block to AGENTS.md in the repo context the scaffold loads; (3) wire two arms — ON-plain (cold-start KB only) and ON-self-learning (onboard-loop with --judge before export). Reuse existing export-kb.js/onboard-loop.js (already proven on a foreign repo). Success: a fast-split instance runs with KB present in AGENTS.md for both ON arms. Depends on FB-2.

summary:
Deliverable 1 (pilot manifest) + 3 (README) DONE & committed (f6f8025, branch orch/attempt/9195fb5e-f196-497d-962f-69616733d2e9-3). Deterministic 15-instance fast-split subset: 5 repos x 3 (pandas-dev/pandas, astropy/astropy, sphinx-doc/sphinx, mwaskom/seaborn, sympy/sympy), each with shared base_commit + github_url, all cleanly cloneable from canonical GitHub at pinned commit (mlflow excluded — bgithub.xyz mirror base_url). Loaded via datasets (py3.12 uv venv, token=None).

Deliverable 2 (two KB variants per repo) BLOCKED, not generated — 3 stacking gaps in the documented pipeline, generating anyway would burn API budget on empty/identical output: (1) the `--judge` flag the eval doc (step 5) + handoff name for the self-learning variant does NOT exist anywhere (onboard-loop/onboard-learn/onboard-harness) — one pipeline only, no way for plain vs selflearn to differ; (2) onboard-loop.js hard-exits without a hand-authored probes.json per repo (onboard-probes.js is only a validator), none exist for the 5 repos; (3) prior verification (task c0bd3682-.../13) recorded foreign-workspace daemon KB injection is policy-denied, so export-kb.js reads back empty for these non-daemon-workspace repos. Escalated via request_guidance g-mqfh5q85-x7gk; blocker note note:note-mqfh3oipxrq. FB-4 is blocked on resolving the variant mechanism + probe generation + foreign-workspace injection policy before any ON-arm KB exists.
